findings.title: Magic number used for free shipping threshold
findings.explanation: The shipping_cost function uses a hard‑coded value of 100 to decide when shipping is free. This makes the threshold difficult to change or configure and reduces code readability.

findings.title: Exclusive comparison may exclude orders at the threshold
findings.explanation: The condition uses a strict greater‑than (>) check, so an order with a total exactly equal to 100 will not receive free shipping. If the business rule intends the threshold to be inclusive, this is a boundary error.

limitations: The ticket does not specify the exact monetary threshold for free shipping nor whether the threshold should be inclusive, so it is unclear whether the > 100 logic matches the intended requirement.
